name: Ash Millworks
old_description: At ASH Millworks, our mission is to provide quality custom cabinetry and other millwork products.
about:
Founded in Petal, Mississippi, by A.S. 'Skipper' Herring about thirty years ago, ASH Millworks began as a custom millwork shop serving the local community. In 2021, Jimmy Reid and Jeremy Hall acquired the business, bringing a combined 30 years of home remodeling experience—Reid with an architectural background and Hall with a sales background—to continue the founder’s vision of quality wood products for South Mississippi.

The company produces a range of custom and factory-built millwork: cabinets, wood and MDF cabinet doors, entry doors, stair parts, butcherblock countertops, custom moldings, windows and shutters, and specialty items such as hardwood furniture and custom signs. Production relies on computer-aided machine tools to meet precise specifications, though facility size and headcount are not publicly disclosed.

ASH Millworks serves residential builders, remodelers, and homeowners across the Pine Belt and Mississippi Gulf Coast, including Hattiesburg, Gulfport, Biloxi, Wiggins, Columbia, Magee, Jackson, McComb, Brookhaven, Natchez, Hammond, and Slidell. Its customer base spans new construction and renovation projects.

The shop emphasizes a philosophy of 'Custom Cabinets Uniquely Designed for You,' highlighting its experienced team’s workmanship standards and the use of computer-aided machining to deliver consistent quality. The founders’ original goal was to bring high-quality custom wood products to their hometown, a mission the current owners say they continue.
